name: Lyon teacher entering data analysis

context.occupation: Secondary-school teacher retraining for data analysis
context.seniority: Entry level in data; completed training and portfolio projects, no industry experience
context.employment_state: Transitioning out of teaching after training
constraints: Training and project work must be considered without industry experience
context.company_awareness: No fixed employer shortlist; knows education better than local data employers

trigger: Finishes a data project portfolio and discovers that several junior advertisements demand professional experience or sell another course.

searches_run.query: data analyst junior Lyon débutant reconversion emploi
searches_run.observation: Retrieval mixed employer vacancies, alternance, internships, a career guide and training providers. One direct employer junior vacancy was a CDI, but inspection showed two to three years of BI experience required.

searches_run.query: data analyst junior sans expérience première expérience emploi France
searches_run.observation: Results included beginner-job aggregations, training/career content and discussions about obtaining a first role. A junior label therefore did not isolate a no-experience vacancy in this retrieval.

sources.title: Data Analyst Junior F/H — ARC Europe France
sources.supports: Directly inspected employer posting calls the role junior but requests two to three years of BI experience and advanced English; this single example demonstrates title/requirements mismatch.

sources.title: Alternance Data Analyst Junior — Groupe Atlantic
sources.supports: Retrieved employer result describes a one-year alternance starting September 2025, illustrating contract and date distinctions, not a current accessible opening.

sources.title: Data analyst junior : ses missions + comment débuter — Coursera
sources.supports: Retrieved career/training content answers beginner questions; the result set includes education content despite employment intent.

best_entry_page.promise: Explain how to read experience and contract requirements in junior data advertisements, using dated examples that distinguish jobs, internships, alternance and training.
best_entry_page.cta: Explorer les offres et vérifier les exigences
proof_needed: Dated employer examples with exact required versus preferred experience
Clear handling of missing requirements as unknown
Verified coverage of Lyon employers before adding a local jobs claim
A real route into role and location search without a pre-existing company list
New indexable guide; existing search pages are noindex

conversion_objections: Does junior actually mean no commercial experience?
Will I see another course funnel?
Can I search without knowing employers?
Does a French advertisement mean French is sufficient at work?
Can the product distinguish required experience from a preference?

avoid_targeting.reason: The persona has completed training and the product does not offer courses.

avoid_targeting.query: emploi data analyst sans expérience garanti
avoid_targeting.reason: Neither hiring nor acceptance of a career change can be guaranteed.
Credential equivalence is not a demonstrated product service.

message_to_founder: Simulation : J’ai déjà fait la formation et préparé mes projets ; je cherche maintenant un employeur. Montrez-moi les exigences réelles derrière le mot junior et ne me renvoyez pas vers une nouvelle formation.
confidence_and_limits: Synthetic scenario, not an interview. Only two queries were run; other searches are hypotheses. Retrieved results are not ranking, volume or employability evidence. One inspected posting establishes a concrete mismatch, not its prevalence. Teaching skills may be relevant but employer acceptance is unknown. No current Lyon coverage was verified.

search_journey.fit_reason: Role/location fits; local coverage is unverified.
Seniority filtering helps but cannot establish eligibility.
Technology labels may help; no-experience acceptance requires reading.
